create.title: Create New Course

knowledge.title: Tutor knowledge base
knowledge.description: Documents the AI Tutor uses to answer this course's learners.
knowledge.tutorOff: The AI Tutor is off for this course. Documents are kept, but learners only see the chat after you turn the option on in About the course.
knowledge.uploadHint: .docx or .pdf file up to 20 MB. Scanned PDFs (images only) are not accepted.
knowledge.uploaded: "{name}" was added to the knowledge base
knowledge.readOnly: Only the course owner, collaborators and administrators can add or delete documents.
knowledge.empty: No sources yet. Upload a document or turn the AI Tutor on to index the course content.
knowledge.courseContentHint: Updated automatically when the course is saved with the tutor on.
knowledge.deleteConfirm: Delete "{name}" from the knowledge base? The tutor stops using this content.
knowledge.loadError: Could not load the tutor knowledge base.
knowledge.previewImagesNote: Text preview; images in the document only show in the downloaded file.
knowledge.accessDescription: Each exported package carries a key that unlocks the tutor for this course. If a package circulates outside the LMS, generate a new key: packages already exported stop answering and the course must be exported again.
knowledge.regenerateConfirm: Generate a new key? SCORM packages already exported for this course lose access to the tutor until they are exported again.
knowledge.regenerated: New key generated. Export the course again so learners can use the tutor.
